annotations.title: Proof of reserve: Chainlink PoR feeds vs onchain supply for WBTC, cbBTC, TUSD, stETH, eETH, with staleness

description: Use when an agent checks whether a wrapped or backed token's reported reserves cover its supply. Input: optional asset (WBTC, cbBTC, TUSD, stETH, eETH). Output: JSON per asset Chainlink Proof of Reserve value, totalSupply by chain, ratio, reserves minus supply, below-supply flag, supply coverage (full/partial), feed age vs heartbeat, stale flag, feed page. Reported reserves, not an audit. Behavior: omit asset for all five. Values come from Chainlink Proof of Reserve feeds and token totalSupply reads; a feed older than its heartbeat is flagged stale. Snapshot cached 5 min. Use instead: rwa_treasuries for tokenized Treasury funds; token_controls for issuer powers. Example: ?asset=WBTC Price: $0.003 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
